title: Fraction of ions hitting B
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 1/2 (or 0.5).

title: Voltage for full landing
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 3.2 × 10⁵ V (or 320,000 V).

title: Voltage for one-third fraction
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be -1400 V.

title: Geometry for angular fraction
description: Important: Correctly identifies the angular range (e.g., 90°) for ions hitting plate B when U_AB=0.

title: Kinematics for electric acceleration
description: Important: Applies constant-acceleration kinematics correctly in the horizontal direction for parts (2) and (3).

title: Force and acceleration relation
description: Important: Uses a = qE/m = qU/(mL) to relate voltage to horizontal acceleration.

title: Sign convention for voltage
description: Pitfall: Confuses the sign of U_AB (e.g., gives +1400 V instead of -1400 V for part (3)).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Shows unit analysis or confirms units of final voltages are in volts.
